newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chun Tai IPO seen more than 60 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Chun Tai IPO seen more than 60 times subscribed.

text.p: The initial public offer (IPO) of consumer electronics products manufacturer Chun Tai Holdings Ltd is expected to be more than 60 times subscribed, market sources said at the close of public subscription on Friday.
The company is expected to make an official statement on the subscription results on January 29. Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on February 3.
Chun Tai offered 82 million new shares at HK$1.03 each in its Hong Kong IPO, raising net proceeds of about HK$71 million to fund a new production plant in China and finance research and development.
